title: CLUTCH MASTER CYLINDER COMPONENTS

CL–6
CLUTCH – CLUTCH MASTER CYLINDER

CLUTCH MASTER CYLINDER
COMPONENTS

Filler Cap
Float
Reservoir Tank
Slotted Spring Pin
♦ Grommet
Piston
Push Rod
Washer
Lock Nut
Boot
Pin
♦ Snap Ring
Clevis
Clip

♦ Non-reusable part

MASTER CYLINDER REMOVAL

Installation is in the reverse order of removal.
1. DRAIN OUT FLUID WITH SYRINGE
INSTALLATION HINT: After installation, adjust the clutch
pedal and bleed the clutch system.
2. DISCONNECT CLUTCH LINE UNION
Using SST, disconnect the union nut.
SST 09023–00100
Torque: 15 N·m (155 kgf·cm, 11 ft·lbf)
3. REMOVE CLIP AND PIN
4. REMOVE 2 MOUNTING NUTS AND PULL OUT MASTER
CYLINDER
Torque: 12 N·m (125 kgf·cm, 9 ft·lbf)
